notes.title: Thank you for your first wishlists!
notes.notes:
[p]To everyone who added [b]Ash & Flame[/b] to their wishlist - thank you from the bottom of my heart.
For a solo indie dev, this means the world. It’s a sign that someone out there is waiting for the game - and that keeps me going.[/p][p]Currently working on the demo version.
More updates are coming soon, and I’d love your feedback along the way.

With respect, Portal In Worlds[/p]
